payload.message:
I have completed an extensive visual and UX polish focusing on the frontend, which affects all 27+ screens through shared styling layers.

- Global CSS improvements include smoother scroll, on-brand focus highlights, branded cyan skeleton loaders, and reusable motion/atmosphere utilities like origin-top menus, drawer slide-ins, tooltips, noise grain, ambient glows, glass/sticky-blur effects, and active/selected states.
- Shared primitives have been enhanced with framer-motion sliding tab indicators, an animated counter (with reduced-motion support) for Overview KPIs, and button/card interaction effects.
- The shell components such as navigation rail, top bar, command palette, and inspector/drawer have polished animations and sticky-blur headers.
- The Overview page now features ambient gradients, staggered tiles, animated counters, prominent headings, and a glowing call-to-action.
- TypeScript checks and smoke screenshots for key screens show no regressions. Automated testing was not performed as per instructions.

Please test the changes by previewing the application and let me know if you observe any issues or if the experience is as expected. I can then proceed with further enhancements, including:

- Animating graph elements with a cinematic reveal.
- Adding branded toast notifications.
- Extending animations to additional dashboards.
- Conducting a reduced-motion accessibility QA.

Additionally, I can add a branded full-page boot splash during initial authentication to enhance the first impression if you’d like.
